title: Circumcision healed before Passover
english: On the Passover at Gilgal, the fruits of the palm country, and the prince of the Lord’s host. The disobedient to the Lord’s commands are called uncircumcised. God sent Jesus who truly circumcises flesh’s pollution and the heart’s sins — not only Nun’s son. [[The circumcised rested in camp until they were healed; then the Lord said: Today I have rolled away Egypt’s reproach >> Bible:Joshua 5:8-9]]. It is not enough to be circumcised; we must heal until the scar closes — when new habits become easy nature. Then Israel kept Passover; no unclean person keeps it. [[Christ our Passover has been sacrificed; let us keep the feast in unleavened sincerity and truth >> Bible:1 Corinthians 5:7-8]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Three foods — Egypt, manna, palm fruits
english: Leaving Egypt they carried dough; when it failed, manna rained; in the holy land they ate palm-country fruit — [[manna ceased >> Bible:Joshua 5:12]]. Three foods: scant school learning from Egypt; in this life’s desert, manna of divine instruction; whoever enters the promised land eats palm fruits — [[face to face what eye has not seen >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:9; 13:12]]. If only the letter stands, better food would yield to worse — absurd; spiritual sense is truer. After bringing his people in, Jesus keeps the Passover.

title: Prince of the Lord’s host
english: [[While Jesus was by Jericho he saw a man with drawn sword: Are you for us or for our adversaries? I am prince of the Lord’s host >> Bible:Joshua 5:13-14]]. Jesus worshiped — [[test the spirits >> Bible:1 John 4:1]]; he knew this was God. Who is that prince but our Lord Jesus Christ, under whom every heavenly host serves? [[Loose your sandal — the place is holy >> Bible:Joshua 5:15]]. Jericho held by enemies becomes holy by the prince’s coming. If God stands with us, let us loose mortal bonds from the soul’s feet — [[feet Jesus washes >> Bible:John 13:8]].

title: Jericho the world falls to trumpet voices
english: Jericho is circled — walls fall not by sword but by priestly trumpets. Jericho figures this world; [[the man who went down from Jerusalem to Jericho >> Bible:Luke 10:30]] images Adam. The blind in Jericho image ignorance’s blindness. The age ends by trumpets: [[The trumpet will sound and the dead rise >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:52]]; [[the Lord will descend with God’s trumpet >> Bible:1 Thessalonians 4:16]]. Only the harlot is saved — the church that received the spies, now [[a chaste virgin to one husband, Christ >> Bible:2 Corinthians 11:2]]. [[Such were some of you, but you were washed and sanctified >> Bible:1 Corinthians 6:11]]. The scarlet cord — the church is saved by Christ’s blood. To him be glory. Amen.
